prior_works.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP
prior_works.relationship_sentence: The paper popularized the tightly coupled "RAG" paradigm (retrieve then condition generation end-to-end), whose coupling of retrieval and free-form generation highlights the very hallucination and entity-dilution problems that the current work explicitly addresses by decoupling retrieval from surface realization.

prior_works.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
prior_works.relationship_sentence: "DPR" introduced learned dense bi-encoder retrieval that the current system adapts conceptually for a conversational dense pool (fine-tuned Qwen 8B adapters) to recover intent-driven matches that lexical signals miss.

prior_works.title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction
prior_works.relationship_sentence: "ColBERT" showed that late-interaction designs preserve exact token-level matching while using contextual encoders, motivating the paper's hybrid lexical--dense retrieval view to retain catalog cues alongside dense conversational signals.

prior_works.title: Adapter-BERT: Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning for NLP
prior_works.relationship_sentence: "Adapter-BERT" framed adapter modules as a compact way to specialize large pretrained models, directly underpinning the current paper's use of task-adapted "Qwen 8B adapters" to build a conversation-focused retrieval pool without full model re-training.

prior_works.title: Fusion-in-Decoder: Unifying Retrieval and Generation for Open-Domain Q&A
prior_works.relationship_sentence: "FiD" operationalized how multiple retrieved contexts can be fused in the decoder for faithful generation, which highlights both the advantages and the limitations of end-to-end fusion and motivates the current paper's choice to instead feed a structured evidence assignment into generation.

prior_works.title: Reciprocal Rank Fusion for Combining Multiple Retrieval Results
prior_works.authors: Gordon V. Cormack and Mark D. Smucker
prior_works.relationship_sentence: "Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)" is the canonical lightweight rank-aggregation method used to merge lexical and dense views, and the current work builds on RRF as an initial cross-view fusion step before supervised calibration with gradient-boosted ranking.

synthesis_narrative: 多条先前工作共同构成了当前系统的具体技术背景。“RAG”提出了紧耦合的“先检索后生成”范式，并揭示了将检索与自由形式生成纠缠在一起可能产生幻觉以及精确实体线索丢失的问题；这种差距映射推动了能够保留离散目录匹配的设计。以“DPR”为代表的学习型稠密检索提供了训练编码器池以捕捉超越表面关键词的对话意图这一核心思想，而“ColBERT”则表明，即使使用上下文编码器，晚期交互与混合设计也能够保留词元级匹配——二者直接启发了本文的混合词汇--稠密池。通过“Adapter-BERT”实现的实用参数高效特化，为在大型模型上使用轻量适配器（此处为“Qwen 8B adapters”）创建对话调优的检索视图而无需全量微调提供了方法论基础。在生成侧，“FiD”展示了如何融合多个检索上下文以进行解码器条件化，从而阐明为何朴素的端到端融合仍可能无法保证有依据且实体准确的解释。最后，诸如“Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)”之类的经典排名聚合提供了一种简单而有效的基线融合，作者在监督重排序之前使用该方法。综合来看，这些工作揭示了一个明确机会：结合能够保留精确目录线索的混合检索架构（词汇视图 + 适配器调优的稠密视图），稳健地聚合互补信号（先RRF，再监督校准），然后用显式的候选级证据约束生成。这种组合自然导向操作上解耦的流水线，并导向本文的propose-assign-select (PAS)证据 grounding 方案，作为实现可靠、可检查的对话解释的下一个逻辑步骤。
